mainEntity.name: How do I register a new company in Australia?

acceptedAnswer.text: Registering a new company involves lodging an application with ASIC, choosing an available company name, appointing directors and shareholders, issuing shares, and adopting a constitution or replaceable rules. A registered accountant handles the full ASIC company registration, issues your ACN, and arranges the company TFN and ABN. Tell us in the questionnaire that you want to register a new company and we will match you with a firm that does it end-to-end.

mainEntity.name: Do I need an ABN and GST registration to start a business?

acceptedAnswer.text: An ABN is required to operate a business, invoice correctly, and avoid no-ABN withholding at the top marginal rate. GST registration is compulsory once your turnover reaches $75,000 (or $150,000 for ride-share and taxi operators). Our matched accountants register your ABN and GST in the correct order so your business is properly set up from day one.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a business name and a company?

acceptedAnswer.text: A business name is a trading name registered with ASIC — it does not create a separate legal entity. A company is a separate legal entity registered with ASIC that can own assets, enter contracts, and limit liability. Our matched advisers help you decide which is right for you and handle either registration.

mainEntity.name: Can a matched accountant register a trust or SMSF?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Setting up a trust requires a compliant trust deed, a trustee appointment, and an ABN and TFN for the trust. An SMSF must be established with a trust deed, trustee appointments, an ABN, TFN, and an ATO election — plus an independent auditor each year. Our matched specialists prepare the documentation and complete every registration correctly.

mainEntity.name: How much does company registration cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: ASIC charges a set fee for company registration, and accountants typically charge a setup fee on top that includes the ACN, company TFN, ABN, and share structure. The matched firm gives you a clear quote before any work begins — the matching service is free to you.

mainEntity.name: How quickly will a matched accountant contact me about registration?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most matches are completed within 60 seconds of finishing the questionnaire. Your matched firm will typically reach out within 2 hours, or you can call for immediate assistance to discuss your registration needs.

Yes. The matching service is free for you. We are engaged by the accounting firms in our network, not by you. You are under no obligation to proceed with any matched firm, and the matched firm gives you a clear quote before any work begins.

mainEntity.name: What ongoing compliance do I need after registering a company?

acceptedAnswer.text: Companies must lodge an annual review with ASIC, maintain a register of members, and notify ASIC of changes to officeholders or addresses. GST-registered businesses must lodge BAS, and employers must register for STP2 and Payday Super. Our matched firms set up the compliance calendar so you never miss a deadline.
